direction: NayaNET should feel premium, high-tech, dimensional, alive and coherent rather than like a generic enterprise dashboard.
hub_authority: For the Hub, HUB/DESIGN-CONTRACT.md is the project-specific visual authority; its spectral direction supersedes older Hub guidance that prohibited yellow/gold.
meaning_rule: Depth, glow, motion and iconography should communicate state, relationship, importance or interaction; decorative effects must not compete with readable intelligence.
purpose: The visual-language doctrine of the activation kit: the established direction, the visual vocabulary, meaning over decoration, and the system rule.
system_rule: Use the canonical master design contract and existing tokens and components before inventing new visual primitives.
title: DESIGN / VISUAL LANGUAGE
visual_vocabulary: No pale pink or light-purple text as a primary reading treatment
Full controlled spectral accents are permitted when they carry semantic theme/state, including yellow and gold
